newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-SNAIGE SWINGS TO 625,000 PROFIT IN 1996.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-SNAIGE SWINGS TO 625,000 PROFIT IN 1996.

text.p: Lithuanian refrigerator company Snaige said on Friday an international audit showed its 1996 profit rose to 625,000 litas from a 3.4 million litas loss a year earlier.
Snaige president Antanas Andrulionis told Reuters by telephone the company expected its 1997 net profit to be two million litas.
He also said the company planned to increase its share capital, which is 19.02 million litas, by 20 million litas in the second half of 1997.
"We have contracts for the whole year already and our contracts are expanding," Andrulionis said.
"15 percent of our products are sold on the domestic market and the rest is exported to 15 countries -- France, The Netherlands, Belgium and Germany mainly," he added.
The company is due to hold its general shareholders meeting on Saturday.

He said 1996 turnover fell to 145.1 million litas from 195 million in 1995. He also said the company's operational profit rose to 3.86 million litas last year from a loss of 2.6 million a year earlier.
